title: Commerce terms
description: Settlement currency, payment amount, and itemized line items for the commercial half of an order. The currency is a TERM of the agreement — a merkle leaf under agreementHash like every other term — and it is written by the checkout walk exactly as payment is: the assembly's figaro-utility-token pin when the designer composed one, else the buyer's pick from the seller's accepted tokens, else the seller's default. The kernel commitment's currency field MIRRORS this leaf (execution data beside the signed term), and the sign gate asserts the two match before either party signs.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: ERC-20 settlement token address — the term the kernel commitment's currency field mirrors.

fields.name: payment
fields.description: Payment amount in the currency's smallest unit. Must be > 0.

fields.name: lineItems
fields.description: Itemized line items. May be empty for non-itemized orders.
